## Passages
RESULT [labelnoise]: On AI-TOD-v2.0, missing and extra labels cost under 2 mAP points even at 60% noise. Class shifts cut mAP from 15.8 to about 14.6 at 30% noise, while 30% box noise nearly halves mAP (15.8 to about 8). DN-TOD adds +4.9 mAP over RFLA under 40% mixed noise.
US [labelnoise]: Small weed seedlings in field images are tiny objects. This ranking suggests that box-geometry noise from OWLv2 auto-labels and class swaps deserve more checking than missed boxes. The result is from aerial tiny objects, so re-measure the ranking on cwd12 with injected noise before relying on it.
CORRECTION [labelnoise]: Confirmed: missing and extra labels cost under 2 mAP at 60%, and 30% box noise 'nearly half' the mAP (about 15.8→8). The class-shift figure of about 14.6 at 30% is read off a chart (Fig. 3). DN-TOD adds +4.9 over RFLA under 40% mixed noise.
